Filter lists shipped with DriveVault Browser Pro (a snapshot; the program can update them when the user presses "Update filter lists")
=====================================================================================================================================

  EasyList                      https://easylist.to/easylist/easylist.txt
  EasyPrivacy                   https://easylist.to/easylist/easyprivacy.txt
  Fanboy's Social Blocking List https://easylist.to/easylist/fanboy-social.txt
  Fanboy's Annoyance List       https://easylist.to/easylist/fanboy-annoyance.txt

Copyright The EasyList authors (https://easylist.to/). Each list says in its own header: "Licence: https://easylist.to/pages/licence.html".
That page offers the lists under two licences, to be chosen by the recipient:

  * the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), or
  * the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version (the text is in GPL-3.0.txt next to this file).

DriveVault Browser Pro uses the lists as DATA files (text read at run time); they are not linked into the program. The files in the "filters" folder are shipped
unchanged, exactly as downloaded on the date written in the matching <list>.meta.json file (date, size and SHA-256 of the file). They may be copied, changed and
redistributed under the terms above. The lists the program downloads later are saved in the user's own data folder and replace the snapshot for that user only.

Not a part of DriveVault Browser Pro's own licence (LICENSE.txt), which covers the program, not these lists.
